Dear [Charles](../persons.html#1043),

&nbsp;

I send you the M S of the story of Burrs hoping that it may help your Christmas number, and not be too youthful

Thank you for the Magazine

Yours truly

C M Yonge

Some of the pencil numbers are missing but the arrangement is all right

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd/ C Moor/Great Grimsby.

Postmarked Winchester Oc 8/83.

[^2]: Charles Moor, who was perhaps running a parish magazine, had asked her for a story, and she sent him the MS of one which was about to be published in [Langley Adventures](../books.html#163).
